related.title: 巴德拉太陽能園區
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴德拉太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bhadla Solar Park must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沙漠中的多業主光電園區：地塊模式、220 kV 外送與清洗用水；巴德拉太陽能園區則以極端高溫下的千萬瓩級園區：電價與每 MW 收入、沙塵暴的風載重與無水清潔為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A multi-developer solar park in the desert: the plot model, 220 kV evacuation and water for cleaning; Bhadla Solar Park centres on A gigawatt-scale park in extreme heat: tariff and revenue per megawatt, wind load in sandstorms and waterless cleaning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到巴德拉太陽能園區，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直交流比與削峰」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to Bhadla Solar Park, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC/AC ratio and clipping", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴德拉太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bhadla Solar Park must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 班班太陽能園區
history.text: 2014 年埃及公布再生能源躉購制度；2017 年國際融資到位；2018 年首批電廠併網；2019 年園區大致完工。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2014: Egypt announced its renewable feed-in tariff. 2017: International financing closed. 2018: The first plants were connected. 2019: The park was largely completed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
